requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
requirement.note: Definitions of coordination, the facilitation ban, reporting to Landlord/Tenant Relations, and the private right of action are all in the text.

key_value.evidence: Subsequent violations shall be punished by a fine of not less than $100 and up to $2000, as provided in Chapter 1, General Provisions, Art. I, § 1-25. Each day during which an owner is in violation of § 218-12 shall constitute a separate violation hereunder.
key_value.note: The $100-$2,000 range applies to subsequent violations, and each day is a separate violation. The card omits that the first violation is punished under § 1-25, and 'per day' is a compressed reading.

status.evidence: Adopted on second and final reading after hearing on May 21 2025
status.note: The ordinance was adopted and approved by the Mayor May 22 2025. No repeal or stay appears, so in_force is reasonable. The document gives no effective-date clause.
